s: Utrecht (a city and municipality, the capital of Utrecht province, Netherlands)
Utah (a state in the western United States)

Ute.et: Inherited from Middle High German Uote. High German variant of Oda, short form of names beginning with Germanic ot (“riches”); name of a queen in the Nibelungenlied.

Utopie.et: Borrowed from French utopie, from English utopia, which see for more.
